doc.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Settling in Las Vegas and the kids in school
summary: Buying a house and working the gambling circuit while the children attend school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: They were starting to be school age. And the school system was wonderful. It was a great school system.

And it was really nice living there too, because even though it was Las Vegas, it wasn’t like it is now, it was just like a little sleepy town except for the Strip. The Strip had all the big casinos and everything, and that was kind of bright and wonderful and a lot of great people were coming into the showroom, and so eventually we worked the Thunderbird, and we just started working the gambling circuit because we could have the kids in school, we could be there all the time, and it was another answer to our needs at the time.
